formulas.ebit: explicit EBIT; or revenue * EBIT margin; or revenue * (gross margin - opex ratio). EBIT is after D&A.
formulas.cash_tax: floor_at_zero: max(EBIT,0)*tax_rate; immediate_credit: EBIT*tax_rate. No NOL carryforward is modeled.
formulas.fcff: EBIT - cash_tax + D&A - capex - (operating NWC[t] - operating NWC[t-1])
formulas.nwc: Operating non-cash, non-interest-bearing working capital. Negative balances are allowed.
formulas.forecast_pv: FCFF[t]/(1+WACC)^t; mid_year uses exponent t-0.5 for explicit forecast only
formulas.terminal_value: terminal_FCFF/(WACC-g); always measured at end of year n, discounted by (1+WACC)^n
formulas.enterprise_value: sum(explicit forecast PV) + terminal_value PV; value of operating assets
formulas.net_debt: interest-bearing debt (consistent lease treatment) less excess cash; cash is not added again

precision.output: decimal strings; no additional display rounding

warnings: Stable terminal model requires nonnegative growth, positive ROIC, and normalized operating earnings; banking/insurance balance-sheet models are outside this model.
